written.title: GTA 6 Marketing Ramps Up As Miami Heat Announce Vice City Night That Sounds Very Expensive
written.description: What GamesRadar+, IGN, Kotaku, Push Square and VGC reported about Vice City on 2 October 2026, quoted in their own words with a link to each report.
written.body:
This page collects what named outlets published about Vice City, in their own words. This site wrote none of the sentences in quotation marks below. Each one links to the report it was taken from.

## GamesRadar+, 2 October 2026

[The power of GTA 6 marketing turns NBA goliath Miami Heat into the Vice City Heat for one game, involving an arena makeover, new kits, and, naturally, merch](https://www.gamesradar.com/games/grand-theft-auto/the-power-of-gta-6-marketing-turns-nba-goliath-miami-heat-into-the-vice-city-heat-for-one-game-involving-an-arena-makeover-new-kits-and-naturally-merch/)

The outlet's own summary:

> Rockstar is going for a three-pointer here

> Every Friday GamesRadar+ Your weekly update on everything you could ever want to know about the games you already love, games we know you're going to love in the near future, and tales from the communities that surround them.

> The Miami Heat, to be dubbed the Vice City Heat for this occasion, are up against the Milwaukee Bucks at home, in the Kaseya Center.

> The venue itself already has Vice City branding on it, as part of an extensive marketing campaign within Miami.

> Now, the court will be branded in "special Vice City hardwood" for the occasion, to make sure everyone watching knows exactly what's going on.

> If you can't get to the Kaseya Center or watch live, you can partake through the line of Vice City merchandise .

## IGN, 2 October 2026

[The Miami Heat Will Wear Vice City Colors in an 'All-New Uniform on a Never-Before-Seen Court' to Celebrate GTA 6](https://www.ign.com/articles/miami-heat-gta-6-uniform)

The outlet's own summary:

> The Miami Heat is heading to Vice City for its next NBA match against the Milwaukee Bucks.

> In-game, the Kaseya Center is dubbed the Sahara Arena.

> In Pictures: How GTA 6's Jason and Lucia Have Evolved Since 2023 View 13 Images Yesterday, the top of the Kaseya Center , home of The Heat, was lit up to usher in the collaboration between Rockstar and Miami’s home team.

> GTA 6 costs $79.99 for the Standard Edition.

> The Ultimate Edition, which includes extra in-game content, costs $99.99.

> GTA 6 takes place in Leonida, a fictional recreation of Florida housing its jewel, a virtual recreation of Miami called Vice City.

> By Kirk McKeand Updated : Oct 2, 2026 2:11pm UTC 5 comments Add IGN on Google The Miami Heat is heading to Vice City for its next NBA match against the Milwaukee Bucks.

> The one-night-only event, hosted live on ESPN, has been dubbed A Night in Vice City , and will see the home team donning an “all-new uniform on a never-before-seen court.” Presumably, this means the team is sponsored by Take-Two and Rockstar Games for a GTA 6 marketing stunt.

> A bunch of fancy crossover merch has also appeared on the Miami Heat store , celebrating Vice City.

## Kotaku, 2 October 2026

[GTA 6 Marketing Ramps Up As Miami Heat Announce Vice City Night That Sounds Very Expensive](https://kotaku.com/gta-6-marketing-ramps-up-as-miami-heat-announce-vice-city-night-that-sounds-very-expensive-2000739310)

The outlet's own summary:

> The one night take over happens right before the game launches on November 19

> If you want to own a piece of this big event, the Miami Heat store is already selling a bunch of GTA 6 -themed clothing and merch , including hats and T-shirts.

> As part of this big marketing push, the Miami Heat have announced a massive one-night event where Vice City will take over the team’s uniform, stadium, and more.

> On Friday, the Miami Heat announced a Grand Theft Auto 6- themed takeover night during its upcoming game against the Milwaukee Bucks on November 18. “For one night only, the Heat trade Miami for Vice City,” explained the team’s official social media accounts.

> The match will take place on a “never-before-seen court.” The team will also be wearing new Vice City-themed uniforms.

> For one night only, the HEAT trade Miami for Vice City.

> Join us on November 18, when Vice City hosts the Milwaukee Bucks on a never-before-seen court, wearing an all-new uniform.

> For details, visit https://t.co/ZiEQ2XUxdu pic.twitter.com/KaQC7QGRHQ - Miami HEAT (@MiamiHEAT) October 2, 2026 “A historic partnership, when the HEAT as Vice City host a never-been-done-before event on the eve of the highly anticipated release of Grand Theft Auto VI, ” is how the team describes the big night on the event’s official website.

> This big Vice City-themed takeover will also be broadcast live on ESPN.

> There’s even a shirt that seems to be directly referencing the shirt you get for reaching 100-percent completion in the original GTA: Vice City.

> New look at the fully lit "WELCOME TO Vice City" GTA 6 Sign in Downtown Miami at night by u/The_Struggling_Soul in GTA6 GTA 6 fans have been closely watching and monitoring the Miami Heat’s arena for weeks now as workers built and completed a large “Welcome to Vice City” sign on top of the complex.

## Push Square, 2 October 2026

[GTA 6 Rebrands Miami Basketball Team to Vice City for One Night Only](https://www.pushsquare.com/news/2026/10/gta-6-rebrands-miami-basketball-team-to-vice-city-for-one-night-only)

The outlet's own summary:

> Miami Heat becomes Vice City on 18th November

> A Night in Vice City tips off November 18. pic.twitter.com/zZGGcrYyiS - Miami HEAT (@MiamiHEAT) October 2, 2026 Here are the visual teasers of what the court will look like, and a dark picture of the shirt.

> The new Vice City Collection offers t-shirts and snapback hats to buy, with the former starting at $45 and the latter at $50.

> Completely changing the name of a sports team is a big deal, so for one night only, Vice City will compete in the NBA.

> I really like the 'welcome to Vice City' shirt.

## VGC, 2 October 2026

[Miami Heat NBA team to rebrand as ‘Vice City’ in GTA 6 marketing stunt | VGC](https://www.videogameschronicle.com/news/miami-heat-nba-team-to-rebrand-as-vice-city-in-gta-6-marketing-stunt/)

The outlet's own summary:

> The team will play as Vice City on the eve of GTA 6’s release next month…

> Dubbed “A Night In Vice City,” the event will take place on the eve of the highly anticipated Rockstar Games title’s launch, November 18, when the Heat will take the court as “Vice City” as they host the Milwaukee Bucks.

> As part of the event, Miami Heat will play on a specially constructed “Vice City Court” and appear in a reimagined uniform.

> The team has also teased additional activities and activations throughout Kaseya Center, including special Vice City merchandise.

> Rockstar’s next open-world crime game is set in a fictionalized version of Miami, returning players to Vice City for the first time since 2006’s Grand Theft Auto: Vice City Stories.

Every report above is on the site's fixed source list. A report is not a confirmation: the mark on each linked entry says who said it.
